title: Overview/Dashboard screen should show monthly expected income vs. actual collected (recovery %)
description:
DashboardScreen currently only shows 'today's collections' (todaysCollections stat tile) - there's no monthly expected-income-vs-collected figure on the Overview screen at all. That comparison only exists one level deeper, on the separate Monthly Report screen (MonthlyReportViewModel already has totalCollected and totalDues). A warden checking in for the day wants the recovery picture at a glance on Overview, not only after navigating into Monthly Report.

Needs a clear definition of 'expected income' for the month first: total billed across active tenancies for the period (rent due regardless of payment status), which is a different number from totalDues (which reads as outstanding/unpaid, not total billed) - this should be nailed down before implementing, and the same definition should drive LODGY-99's recovery percentage in the exported report.
acceptanceCriteria: Overview/Dashboard screen shows monthly expected income and actual collected for the current month, scoped consistently with the screen's existing property/hostel scoping
Recovery percentage (collected / expected) is shown, not just the two raw numbers
Definition of 'expected income' is documented in DESIGN.md and reused by LODGY-99's export
Handles zero expected income (no active tenancies) without a divide-by-zero or misleading percentage
